analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW: SPY is in a confirmed uptrend (+0.6% vs SMA50, slope +1.30%), which is constructive, but this is not a reason to force additional exposure. The more important story is the portfolio's performance record: 0% win rate across 8 closed trades, all stopped out at an average of -5.10%. This is a pattern, not bad luck. It signals that entry timing has been systematically early — buying before trends confirm, or before basing completes. The honest response is to slow down, not add more positions.

CURRENT POSITION REVIEW:
- ULTA (+8.84%, $22,459): Thesis intact, trend working. Hold with trailing discipline.
- IT (+12.34%, $9,536): Gartner performing well, uptrend intact. Best performer — let it run.
- FOXA (+2.92%, $12,054): Small gain, holding. Trend neutral. Watch for thesis deterioration.
- NVDA (-0.38%, $15,226): Essentially flat, no signal either way. Hold unless stop triggers.
- AMP (-8.14%, $9,549): This is the concern. Down 8.14% from a $547 entry, now $502. AMP is approaching meaningful drawdown territory. If the original stop was set at ~15% below entry (~$465), there is still room, but the position has not recovered and the trend has not inflected positive. Monitor closely — if price breaks below $490 on volume, consider whether the thesis is broken independent of the stop level.

CAPACITY CHECK: Portfolio is at 5 positions — the hard ceiling of the 3-5 rule. Remaining headroom is only $22,751, and adding a 6th position would violate concentration discipline. No new BUY is appropriate unless a current position exits first.

CANDIDATE SCAN: Several quality names appear interesting on fundamentals (ADBE with fwd P/E 9.15 and PEG 0.58 in basing territory; ADI with strong EPS revisions; CPAY with excellent economics) but none change the capacity math. Many high-ranking candidates are also extended: MPC (+21.6% vs SMA50, 98% of range), APA (97% range), EOG (97% range) — all violate the AVOID extended entries rule. TEL and TYL have earnings in 12d, making entries binary-event gambles. The best-looking setups (ADBE, TEL, ABNB) would require freeing a slot first.

DECISION: Zero new trades. The portfolio is at max positions. The 0% win rate demands reflection, not acceleration. Cash (~29% of equity) is earning the right return: patience. If AMP stops out or thesis breaks, ADBE (basing, lower-half of 52w range, exceptional quality metrics, 54 days to earnings) would be the top replacement candidate at that time. Discipline now preserves optionality later.
